name: Azoth
source:
Vampire girl who serves the Queencroiz and claimed to be the barer of the End. She is Queen's lover.

[spoiler]She was the daughter of alchemists. After her parents death Azoth was raised in a church orphanage. Than some bandits attacked the church she was saved by Ria and Queen. Soon she fell in love with the Queen and left with her. 

Azoth was killed during the attack on Sect Falcon's palace and resurrected later by Nero. [/spoiler]
